claims.text: An AI-enabled customer care journey spans from accurate emotion recognition to empathetic response, emotional management support, and emotional connection establishment.
Strategic deployment of GenAI for emotional connection enhances customer emotional well-being.
Strategic deployment of GenAI for emotional connection enhances customer lifetime value.

evidence.description: The authors develop an AI-enabled customer care journey model integrating accurate emotion recognition, empathetic response, emotional management support, and emotional connection.
Marketing tenets formulated in the paper include strategically deploying GenAI for emotional connection to enhance customer emotional well-being.
Marketing tenets formulated in the paper include strategically deploying GenAI for emotional connection to enhance customer lifetime value.

methodologies.name: Managerial In-depth Interviews and CMO Survey
methodologies.description: In-depth interviews with top managers and a survey of chief marketing officers to derive marketing requirements for each stage of the AI-enabled customer care journey.

limitations.text: Current feeling capabilities of GenAI do not fully meet the derived marketing requirements for customer care, presenting technological challenges.

future_work.text: Verifying emotion recognition accuracy using marketing emotion theories through multiple emotion signals and methods.
Utilizing prompt engineering to enhance GenAI's emotion understanding.
Employing response engineering to personalize emotion management recommendations.
